title: Branch Target
summary: Checks a merge or deploy target against your branch rules, so a feature branch doesn't land in the wrong base.
description: Checks the chosen base against branch rules (feature → main is caught, with a one-tap switch to develop), counts commits the branch would drag in that aren't its own, and flags a head that is behind its target with an Update branch action.
catches: A target the rules don't allow for this head, with a one-tap switch to an allowed one
Commits the merge would bring in that are not the head's own (wrong fork point)
A head that is behind its target
limits: Uses the branch rules, commit lists and fork point you pass; it does not query Git
Wildcard rules are simple * patterns; the first matching rule wins
a11y: Native <select> with a <label>, aria-invalid when blocked and aria-describedby to its hint
server: Enforce branch protection and allowed merge targets in your Git host; this picker is a guide, not a protection rule.
stops: Feature branch merged into wrong base
mistakes: merged into main instead of develop
